emails.subject: {{first_name}}, has this ever happened at {{company_name}}?
emails.body:
{{first_name}}, has {{company_name}} ever had an SDR go on leave and had to scramble to cover their pipeline?

Asking because we've been filling that exact gap for similar-sized teams with senior reps that ramp in days, not months. You only pay for qualified meetings.

Relevant because most teams your size deal with this at least once a year.
